g.text: CA1-A01 · Two coaches on bogies with connected drawbar
Two copies of the current accessible coach; front / rear bogie pivots at45 /261in (5486.4mm spacing).
Nominal full-load floor height812.8mm; use the3D close-up to inspect body adapters, pivots and side supports.
Inter-car bar:800mm eye spacing; pins150mm beyond each body end →1100mm nominal straight body gap.
Drawbar centre550mm above rail. Gap and coupling height are trial installation dimensions, not accepted route interfaces.
One developed C5.5 brake unit per bogie shown; remaining brake positions and air connections are unfinished.
Small seat / truck fasteners omitted in overview; detailed source assemblies retain them.
CA1 R1 · 20 October 2026 · Nominal installation study; no fabrication or operating release.
